chapter_title: Concerning the Gathering in of the [E]lements.

2.content: the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to

fills.fill: the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to
fills.notes: The sequence is a discrete-degree “ladder” of re-integration (inside → outside): elements (fire/water/wind/air) → Answer → Summons → purified Mind/Intellectual → Pillar of Glory → First Man → Ambassador → aeons of Greatness. These are not exhortative titles but functional cosmic offices: the Pillar as axis of ascent, First Man as primal living form receiving the gathered Light, and the Ambassador as the mediating emissary who delivers it into the Great Aeons. The existing reconstruction fits the correspondential chain and preserves the impersonal, technical register of the substrate.

assessment: The single lacuna is tightly constrained by the required ascent-chain structure (successive receptacles of gathered Light). The supplied reading coheres with discrete degrees and the standard cosmological offices, so restoration is secure.
